source_snapshot.items: LC.3_LC Tray Leak - Disconnect Sensor Fault
source_snapshot.procedure: Physically unplug the GB-NV-PVP leak detection sensor from its board.
source_snapshot.criteria: The tray diagnoses a sensor fault and emits the correct BMC signals.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 60/60 minutes; unique GB-NV-PVP row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO/MANUAL; preserves the human disconnect boundary but lacks platform connector, hydraulic/electrical state, exact diagnostics and recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; retained Pending for the GB-NV-PVP asset map, safe access, BMC fault timing and restored protection.

old_problem: The GB-NV-PVP-specific connector, maximum protection-disabled interval, permissible powered/hydraulic state, local diagnostic, BMC channel/timing and safe reconnect oracle are absent. The neighboring generic-HW row cannot establish this platform's wiring path.
disposition_reason: Pending remains because platform connector identity and energized/hydraulic handling are safety-critical hardware semantics, and the exact local/BMC assertion/clear matrix is the missing authoritative result oracle. ED-09/19/20 require manual, independently identified coverage rather than borrowing row 2096. All evidence and restoration phases are specified pending the GB-NV-PVP service document.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2097, its DeepSeek cells, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2098 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00020-V002 / 90ed1d39e5e7a349 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
This case validates the actual GB-NV-PVP harness/board continuity path; software fault injection and the generic row-2096 connector map are not equivalent.
Before access, prove the exact tray, board input, sensor, harness, connector/latch and BMC channel identity with platform documentation and photos.
A signed state table must define power, touch safety, coolant pressure/flow, pump/valve state and the maximum interval during which leak protection may be impaired.
One qualified manual open must correlate with the exact local diagnostic and full BMC/Redfish/SEL assertion; evidence stays unfiltered and timestamped.
Reconnect is coverage: inspect pins/latch/strain relief and prove electrical continuity, diagnostic deassertion, normal sensor monitoring and any actuator restoration.
Stop on moisture, heat/arcing, wrong connector, damage, unexpected cooling action, late/missing alarm or failed recovery; never repeat.
No connector, power/coolant state, BMC query, disconnect/reconnect, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: GB-NV-PVP leak-sensor harness open and protection recovery — PROCEDURE PENDING
test_case.purpose: Temporarily open the documented GB-NV-PVP leak-sensor circuit once, prove the platform's local and BMC diagnostics, then restore connector integrity and the complete leak-protection function.
required_package: Approved powered/de-energized, coolant flow/pressure, pump/valve and access-state table
Platform-qualified operator, ESD/latch/cable controls and maximum impairment interval
Exact local diagnostic and BMC channel/event assertion/deassertion/timing oracle
Connector inspection, continuity/fault-clear, actuator and return-to-service recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: NO REMOTE EXECUTION COMMAND. Keep the connector untouched until the platform service contract is signed. Qualified personnel document the exact GB-NV-PVP path and approved electrical/hydraulic state, capture physical and full BMC baseline, then with point approval unlatch and open only that connector once. Timestamp the open, local diagnosis and every BMC event. Before the impairment limit, preserve evidence and under separate approval inspect/reseat; prove fault clear, normal monitoring and restored cooling/protection state. Never simulate, substitute row 2096 or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until the platform contract is supplied. The mapped physical open must assert the specified GB-NV-PVP sensor-fault and BMC signals within limits, cause only approved protective behavior, and the inspected reseat must clear diagnostics and restore reliable sensing and all affected cooling states.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while platform identity, safe state, impairment limit, signal/timing and recovery are unknown. After unlock, PASS requires one controlled open on the exact connector, complete local/BMC correlation, no unsafe collateral effect, intact reseat, timely clear and proven protection restoration. FAIL on identity error, absent/wrong/late alarm, service-limit breach, damage, intermittent contact or recovery failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until GB-NV-PVP service map, energy/hydraulic state, impairment limit and recovery are approved.
Require platform-qualified personnel and separate point approvals for opening and reseating.
Use latch/ESD controls, never pull wires, and preserve evidence before restoring the protection circuit.
Stop without retry on moisture, arcing/heat, damage, unexpected pump/valve/power action or failed diagnostic clear.
expected_evidence: Exact GB-NV-PVP row/variant/hash and proof no generic-HW map was substituted
Signed tray/board/harness/sensor/connector/channel map and operator safe-state checklist
Baseline photos showing latch/pins/strain relief plus normal local/BMC/cooling state
Timestamped single disconnect and protection-impairment duration
Complete local diagnostic and unfiltered BMC/Redfish/SEL assertion identity/severity/timing
Reseat inspection, fault deassertion, normal sensing/cooling/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If the wrong path is opened, hardware is damaged, alarm behavior differs or the impairment deadline/recovery fails, stop and preserve the state. Do not try a neighboring connector or repeat. Follow the GB-NV-PVP isolation/reconnect document and keep the cooling protection/node out of service until owner release.
